data.title: 黑呆 · 黑色丝绸大床的傲慢仰卧交付
data.description: 【成年黑化阿尔托莉雅 · 黑绸魔力回响】二十岁以上成年版本的黑化骑士王独自仰卧在黑色丝绸床褥上。暗色礼裙与胸甲已经解开并堆在腰侧，她屈起双腿，一手按住裸露胸部，另一手探向腿间；紫黑魔力从指尖沿床单扩散，金色眼睛在阴影里保持命令般的凝视。散落的王冠与黑剑只作背景，不出现任何伴侣。

data.promptProse: Amber candlelight cuts across adult, age-twenty-plus Artoria Pendragon Alter lying alone on black silk sheets. Her dark ceremonial gown and breastplate are unfastened and gathered at the waist, exposing bare breasts above both knees drawn into the vertical frame. One hand presses her chest while the other moves between her thighs, releasing violet-black mana through the bedding. A discarded crown and blackened sword remain in the background as golden eyes keep an imperious stare through flushed cheeks and parted lips. Vertical solo portrait, no text or extra people.
